summary: Sandbach United made a winning start to the 2026/27 season with a hard-fought 1-0 victory over Stafford Town, with a first-half goal from Tatters securing all three points and a clean sheet. The Bach showed resilience throughout the match against a tough opponent, with manager making defensive adjustments late on to see out the result. It's the perfect opening day result to build momentum as the campaign gets underway.
